# awscc_networkmanager_context_store (Resource)

Creates a Context Store paired to a Global Network for sharing network context with firewall vendors.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the context store.
- `global_network_id` (String) The ID of the global network.
- `tags` (Attributes Set) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `context_store_arn` (String) The ARN of the context store.
- `context_store_id` (String) The ID of the context store.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `state` (String) The state of the context store (PENDING / AVAILABLE / UPDATING / DELETING / DELETED).

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String)
- `value` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_networkmanager_context_store.example
  identity = {
    context_store_id = "context_store_id"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `context_store_id` (String) The ID of the context store

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_networkmanager_context_store.example
  id = "context_store_id"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_networkmanager_context_store.example "context_store_id"
```
